unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: DIQQAT — bet raqami siljishi shu betdan boshlab o'zgaradi. Modul muqovasi (PDF 36–37) raqamlanmagani uchun: 33-betgacha PDF = bet + 2, 34-betdan boshlab PDF = bet + 4.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences and circle the correct answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri javobni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — KUNDALIK TARTIB.

Sarlavha: 'An Early Bird or a Night Owl?'
  an early bird — erta turadigan odam
  a night owl   — kech yotadigan odam

Ikkalasi ham QUSH obrazi:
  Maqol: 'The early bird catches the worm'
         (Erta turgan qush qurtni tutadi)
         O'zbekchada: 'Erta turgan er oshini topar'
  Boyqush (owl) esa KECHASI ov qiladi — shuning uchun
  kech yotadigan odamni 'night owl' deyishadi.

Rasmda Bob Ellis — delfin murabbiyi. U delfin ustida turibdi.

items.textEn: 1  The man in the picture is Bob Ellis. He is a ____ .
items.whyUz: Rasmda delfin bilan ishlaydi. Matnda ham: 'Bob Ellis, 29, is a dolphin trainer'. Akula (shark) o'rgatilmaydi.
Matnda: 'He arrives at the aquarium at half past six'. Basseyn — u faqat suzish uchun boradi.
U murabbiy: delfinlarni boqadi va o'rgatadi. Akvarium tozalash — boshqa odamning ishi.
Matnda: 'It is tiring though, as I work long hours'. U ishini YOQTIRADI — demak zerikarli emas.

items.textEn: 5  An early bird is someone who ____ .
items.whyUz: 'early' = erta. Erta turadigan odam.

items.textEn: 6  An owl is a bird which sleeps ____ .
items.whyUz: Boyqush KECHASI ov qiladi, demak KUNDUZI uxlaydi. Shuning uchun kech yotadigan odamni 'night owl' deyishadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences about Bob Ellis, then listen and write T (for true) or F (for false).
exercises.instructionUz: Bob Ellis haqidagi gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Barcha javoblarni 3-mashqdagi matndan ham topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapni matndagi aniq ma'lumot bilan solishtiring.
Bitta raqam yoki so'z farq qilsa ham — javob F.

DIQQAT — chalg'ituvchi juftliklar:
  six o'clock ↔ five o'clock
  the train   ↔ the bus

items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Matnda aynan shunday: 'I like my job a lot because I love working with animals'.
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'as I work long hours'. 'long hours' = uzoq soat, ko'p ishlash.

items.sentence: 3  His day starts at six o'clock in the morning.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'His day starts at FIVE o'clock in the morning'. Soat oltida u avtobusga chiqadi.

items.sentence: 4  He catches the train to work.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'he catches the BUS to work'. 'catch the bus' = avtobusga chiqmoq.

items.sentence: 5  In the evening, Bob usually watches TV.
items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Matnda aynan shunday: 'In the evening, Bob usually watches TV'.

items.sentence: 6  He loves going for long walks in the countryside.
items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'He loves going for long walks in the countryside with his dog, Jack'.

sections.title: Reading — Around the Clock with Bob Ellis

exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing — har bir gapning tarjimasi va izohi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA: 'Around the Clock with Bob Ellis'
  'around the clock' — sutka bo'yi, kun bo'yi
  (soat strelkasi butun aylanani bosib o'tadi degani)

MATN TARTIBI — KUN BO'YICHA:
  1) kasbi va unga munosabati
  2) ertalab: turish → dush → kiyinish → nonushta → yo'l
  3) ish: delfin boqish → mashq → tushlik → tomosha
  4) kechqurun: uy, televizor, erta yotish
  5) bo'sh vaqt: sayr, suzish
  6) hayotdan qoniqish

BUTUN MATN PRESENT SIMPLE da — chunki bu KUNDALIK TARTIB.
Har bir fe'lga qarang: 'gets', 'has', 'catches', 'arrives',
'feeds' — hammasi 3-shaxs birlik -s bilan.

sentences.en: Around the Clock with Bob Ellis
Bob Ellis, 29, is a dolphin trainer.
sentences.noteUz: Gazetalarda yosh ism bilan vergul orasida beriladi: 'Bob Ellis, 29, is ...'

sentences.en: "I like my job a lot because I love working with animals," he says.
sentences.uz: 'Ishimni juda yoqtiraman, chunki hayvonlar bilan ishlashni yaxshi ko'raman', — deydi u.
sentences.noteUz: 'love' dan keyin -ING: love WORKING. 'work WITH' — bilan ishlamoq.

sentences.en: "It is tiring though, as I work long hours."
sentences.uz: 'Lekin bu charchatadi, chunki ko'p soat ishlayman.'
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: long hours = uzoq ish soatlari.
'though' = lekin (gap o'rtasida ham bo'ladi).
'as' bu yerda 'chunki' ma'nosida (because bilan bir xil).

sentences.en: His day starts at five o'clock in the morning.
sentences.uz: Uning kuni ertalab soat beshda boshlanadi.
sentences.noteUz: Soat bilan AT. 'in the morning' — ertalab.

sentences.en: He gets up, has a shower, and then he gets dressed.
sentences.uz: U turadi, dush qabul qiladi, so'ng kiyinadi.
sentences.noteUz:
UCH TURG'UN BIRIKMA:
  get up — turmoq (uyqudan)
  have a shower — dush qabul qilmoq
  get dressed — kiyinmoq

sentences.en: After breakfast, at about six o'clock, he catches the bus to work.
sentences.uz: Nonushtadan keyin, taxminan soat oltida, u ishga avtobusga chiqadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'catch the bus' = avtobusga chiqmoq (ushlamoq emas!).
'at about six' — taxminan oltida.

sentences.en: He arrives at the aquarium at half past six and feeds the dolphins.
sentences.uz: U akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi va delfinlarni boqadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'arrive AT' — kichik joyga (bino, bekat).
'half past six' = 6:30 (oltidan yarim o'tdi).

sentences.en: After that, they practise for the show until lunchtime.
sentences.uz: Shundan keyin ular tushlikkacha tomosha uchun mashq qilishadi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: practise = mashq qilmoq (Britan imlosi; AQShda 'practice').
'until' = ...gacha.

sentences.en: Bob has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one, then the show starts.
sentences.uz: Bob o'n ikki yarimdan bir yarimgacha tushlik uchun tanaffus qiladi, so'ng tomosha boshlanadi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: a break = tanaffus.
'from ... till ...' = ...dan ...gacha.

sentences.en: At five o'clock in the afternoon, he feeds the dolphins again and then he goes home.
sentences.uz: Kunduzi soat beshda u delfinlarni yana boqadi, so'ng uyga ketadi.

sentences.en: In the evening, Bob usually watches TV.
He doesn't go out very often during the week because he goes to bed early.
sentences.uz: U hafta davomida tez-tez ko'chaga chiqmaydi, chunki erta yotadi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: during = davomida; early = erta.
'go out' = ko'chaga chiqmoq, dam olishga chiqmoq.
'go to bed' — 'the' YO'Q.

sentences.en: And what does Bob do in his free time?
sentences.uz: Xo'sh, Bob bo'sh vaqtida nima qiladi?
sentences.noteUz: Matn ichida savol — o'quvchi diqqatini yangi mavzuga tortadi.

sentences.en: He loves going for long walks in the countryside with his dog, Jack.
sentences.uz: U iti Jek bilan qishloqda uzoq sayr qilishni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: long walks = uzoq sayrlar; countryside = qishloq joy, shahardan tashqari.
'go for a walk' = sayrga chiqmoq.

sentences.en: Bob also likes swimming at the pool, but he never swims in the sea because he's afraid of sharks!
sentences.uz: Bob basseynda suzishni ham yoqtiradi, lekin dengizda hech qachon suzmaydi, chunki akuladan qo'rqadi!
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: afraid of = ...dan qo'rqmoq ('of' SHART).
'never' — inkor so'zi, 'doesn't' kerak emas.

sentences.en: "I feel very satisfied with my life at the moment," says Bob.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: feel = his qilmoq; satisfied = mamnun, qoniqqan.
'satisfied WITH' — 'with' shart. 'at the moment' = hozir.

sentences.en: "I've got a great job and I enjoy my free time. Who could ask for more?"
sentences.uz: 'Menda ajoyib ish bor va bo'sh vaqtimdan zavqlanaman. Bundan ortiq nima kerak?'
sentences.noteUz: 'Who could ask for more?' — 'Bundan ortiq nima kerak?' — mamnunlikni bildiruvchi ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Oltita savol. Oxirgisi GRAMMATIK savol — matnning zamoni haqida.

Javobda 'because' bilan sabab ayting — bu ball oshiradi
va matnni tushunganingizni ko'rsatadi.

items.textEn: 1  Does Bob like his job? Why (not)?
items.answer: Yes, he does. He likes his job a lot because he loves working with animals.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'I like my job a lot because I love working with animals'. Javobda 'I' → 'he' ga o'zgaradi.
Matnda: 'It is tiring though, as I work long hours'. 'as' = 'because'.

items.textEn: 3  What does Bob do in the morning?
items.answer: He gets up at five o'clock, has a shower, gets dressed and has breakfast. At about six o'clock he catches the bus to work. He arrives at the aquarium at half past six and feeds the dolphins.
items.whyUz: Ertalabki tartib — matnning ikkinchi xatboshisidan.

items.textEn: 3  What does Bob do in the afternoon?
items.answer: He has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one, then the show starts. At five o'clock he feeds the dolphins again and then he goes home.
items.whyUz: Tushdan keyingi tartib.

items.textEn: 3  What does Bob do in the evening?
items.answer: He usually watches TV. He doesn't go out very often because he goes to bed early.
items.whyUz: Kechqurungi tartib.

items.textEn: 4  What does Bob do in his free time?
items.answer: He loves going for long walks in the countryside with his dog. He also likes swimming at the pool, but he never swims in the sea.
items.whyUz: Uchinchi xatboshi. 'like/love' dan keyin -ING.

items.textEn: 5  How does Bob feel about his life?
items.answer: He feels very satisfied with his life. He has got a great job and he enjoys his free time.
items.whyUz: Oxirgi xatboshi. 'feel satisfied WITH' — predlog shart.

items.textEn: 6  What tense do we use to describe daily routines?
items.whyUz: Kundalik tartib va odatlar uchun Present Simple ishlatiladi (Unit 4 qoidasi).

exercises.explanationUz: Matndagi o'nta qalin so'z — Unit 5 ning asosiy lug'ati.

items.whyUz: 'work long hours' = ko'p soat ishlamoq.
Britan imlosi -se bilan. AQShda 'practice'. Ot shakli Britaniyada ham 'practice'.
'have a break' = tanaffus qilmoq. 'break' fe'l sifatida — sindirmoq.
'during the week' = hafta davomida. Keyin OT keladi, gap emas.
'go to bed early' = erta yotmoq. Aksi: late (kech).
'go for long walks' = uzoq sayr qilmoq.
'the' bilan ishlatiladi. 'a village' — aniq bir qishloq, 'the countryside' — umuman tabiat.
'be afraid OF' — 'of' SHART. 'afraid from' XATO.
'feel + sifat': feel happy, feel tired, feel satisfied.
'satisfied WITH' — 'with' shart.

wordFormation.introUz: 34-bet — kundalik tartib fe'llari va his-tuyg'u sifatlari.

groups.explanationUz: 'get' fe'li ko'p turg'un birikmalarda uchraydi. Ularni butun holda yodlang.
Ovqat va yuvinish 'have' fe'li bilan aytiladi — bu o'zbekchadan farq qiladi.
Ba'zilarida 'to' bor, ba'zilarida yo'q — bu eng ko'p xato manbai.
-ing narsani tasvirlaydi (u shunday qiladi), -ed odamni tasvirlaydi (u shunday his qiladi).
Bu sifatlar ma'lum predlog talab qiladi — juftlik holida yodlang.

patterns.formula: His/Her day starts AT + soat + IN THE + kun qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: His day starts at five o'clock in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning kuni ertalab soat beshda boshlanadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Soat bilan AT, kun qismi bilan IN THE (morning/afternoon/evening).
ISTISNO: at night ('in the night' EMAS).

patterns.formula: He gets up, has a shower, and then he gets dressed.
patterns.exampleEn: He gets up, has a shower, and then he gets dressed.
patterns.exampleUz: U turadi, dush qabul qiladi, so'ng kiyinadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ketma-ket harakatlar vergul bilan, oxirgisidan oldin 'and then'.
Har bir fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi.

patterns.formula: He catches the bus TO work. He arrives AT + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: He catches the bus to work. He arrives at the aquarium at half past six.
patterns.exampleUz: U ishga avtobusga chiqadi. Akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'catch the bus' — avtobusga chiqmoq.
'arrive AT' — kichik joy (bino), 'arrive IN' — shahar/mamlakat.

patterns.formula: somebody has a break FROM + vaqt + TILL + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: Bob has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one.
patterns.exampleUz: Bob o'n ikki yarimdan bir yarimgacha tanaffus qiladi.

patterns.formula: He doesn't + fe'l + very often BECAUSE + sabab.
patterns.exampleEn: He doesn't go out very often during the week because he goes to bed early.
patterns.exampleUz: U hafta davomida tez-tez ko'chaga chiqmaydi, chunki erta yotadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'very often' inkor bilan — 'unchalik tez-tez emas'.
'during' + ot ('during the week').

patterns.formula: He NEVER + fe'l + BECAUSE he's afraid OF + narsa.
patterns.exampleEn: He never swims in the sea because he's afraid of sharks.
patterns.exampleUz: U dengizda hech qachon suzmaydi, chunki akuladan qo'rqadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'never' o'zi inkor — 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.
'afraid OF' — predlog shart.

patterns.exampleEn: I feel very satisfied with my life at the moment.
patterns.explanationUz:
'feel' dan keyin sifat (ravish emas): feel GOOD (feel well ham bo'ladi).
'satisfied WITH' — predlog shart.
